verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code fetch and manage information and incidents in a PagerDuty account. That makes natural-language operation of the product a first-party capability. Its Insights Agent adds on-demand conversational analytics natively. missing for 10: documentation of which operations the MCP tools actually cover, a native in-product natural-language command interface beyond analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
